name: christianmacion-portfolio
description: Christian T. Macion — AI Engineer + Quantitative Researcher. Personal portfolio site.

scripts.prebuild: node scripts/build-resumes.mjs && node scripts/build-resumes-md.mjs && node scripts/build-og-image.mjs && node scripts/optimize-assets.mjs && node scripts/build-earth-110m.mjs && node scripts/fetch-gdelt.mjs && node scripts/build-graph-snapshot.mjs
scripts.build: export BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ); astro build && node scripts/build-llms-full.mjs
scripts.build:verify: npm run build && npm run smoke:build
scripts.postbuild: node scripts/asset-audit.mjs && pagefind --site dist --output-subdir _pagefind && python3 tools/scorecard_aggregator.py
scripts.ci: npm run lint:md && npm run lint && npm run lint:styles && npm run format:check && npm run knip && npm run no-bulbs && npm run build && npm run no-f14 && npm run no-halo && npm run check:bundle && npm run audit && npm run sitemap:check
scripts.no-halo: grep -rn 'box-shadow:\s*0\s*0\s*[1-9][0-9]' src/ 2>/dev/null && echo 'FAIL: halo/glow box-shadow detected' && exit 1 || echo 'PASS: no halo/glow box-shadows'
scripts.nda:guard: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const banned=['19V Capital','Macion Capital','Arclion AI','Quantivo','CallRank','Davao City'];let bad=0;function walk(d){for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,f.name);if(f.isDirectory())walk(p);else if(/\.(html|txt|md|json|pdf)$/.test(f.name)){try{const buf=fs.readFileSync(p);const c=buf.toString('latin1');for(const b of banned)if(c.includes(b)){console.error('NDA leak:',p,'contains',b);bad++;}}catch(e){}}}}walk('dist');if(bad>0){console.error('NDA:guard FAIL — '+bad+' leak(s) detected');process.exit(1);}else{console.log('NDA:guard PASS — dist/ clean');}"
